Text: Check everything about your or someone else's base using the "/profile" command.
The "/leaderboard" command lets you compare your progress against others.
Obstacles randomly spawn around your village. "/check_obstacles" saves them to your village and "/remove_obstacle" removes them for a small amount of Gems.
See what Magic Items you have with "/profile Magic Item", use them with "/use [Magic Item name]", and sell them with "/sell".
Don't leave your Collectors, Mines, and Drills full! "/collect_loot" will generate passive resources for you.
Use the "/view" command to see how your Resource generators and Upgraders are doing.
Type "/help" to see a list of all the commands.
Do you enjoy playing Chester? Donations are accepted through "/support"!
Ran out of space to store loot? Either upgrade your storages or Clan Castle (Resources category).
Which Cosmetics and Hero Equipments you own, and which are you still looking for? Check it with "/profile [Category name]".
Nowhere to spend your hard-earned resources? Upgrade some buildings using the "/upgrade [Category name] [Item name]" command.
Get a specific cosmetic or Epic Equipment with the "/buy" command.
Need resources in a pinch? Transfer some of your Treasury resources to your storages with "/collect_treasury".
You can buy more Builders with Gems using the "/buy" command.
If you want to check how much an upgrade costs or how long it takes, use the "/upgradeinfo" command.
Want to upgrade your Town Hall? Use the "/remaining" command to check which upgrades are left.
Started the wrong upgrade? Use the "/cancel" command to get half of your resources back.
See your recent finished upgrades with the /history Upgrades command.
Upgrading your offensive units is crucial to strong attacking results.
Some Magic Items can increase your attacking power.
Some units are used in every type of attack while most aren't. Pay attention to what's used more often and upgrade it first!
